title: Deploy record (append-only; written BY the act of deploying, never by hand)

sha.description: Immutable artifact Git SHA. The HTTP writer accepts a new record only after served_sha exactly matches it.

audit_ok.description: Must be derived by the trusted deploy writer from the gate exit; the schema alone cannot prove it.

served_sha.description: Exact SHA independently observed at the public front door; new HTTP records require equality with sha.

tasks_closed.description: Explicit immutable set of done task ids carried by this release.
